reference_gate: Continuous plausible body/trousers extending through source-matched lower framing, no abrupt floating cutoff or extra legs/subject; exact prepared-reference pixels outside mask. Inspect raw Qwen separately from protected reference. Neutral original upper pose is known, not a still pose-transfer pass. If any fails, stop.
video_gate: Unchanged RUBRIC: every applicable visual dimension>=3/4, >=28/33clear defining-attribute frames, no major anatomical collapse, >=3/4 source events within2frames. Every raw and composite frame separately; normal speed where playback available. Any fail stops.
comparison: Same source, mask, model weights/seed/sampler/video graph and upper reference pixels; new lower reference region. Qwen conditioned source is registered reference, not source-person RGB. No new generator weights.
unseen: Only after video pass: genuinely different licensed recording selected source-only, freeze four timing events and candidate before first output. No old recordings/crops/mirrors. Complete pipeline includes registration, masked reference and video.
